title: Carrier Strike Group 12
extract: Carrier Strike Group Twelve is one of four U.S. Navy carrier strike groups currently assigned to the United States Fleet Forces Command. USS Gerald R. Ford is the aircraft carrier assigned as the strike group's flagship. Units currently assigned to Carrier Strike Group Twelve include Carrier Air Wing Eight, the Arleigh Burke-class USS Winston S. Churchill (DDG-81) and Destroyer Squadron 2.
